definitions.full: H8497. takah [ תָּכָה ] verb meaning wholly dubious; — Pu`al Perfect 3plural לְרַגְלֶ֑ךָ תֻּכּוּ וְהֵם Deut 33:3 ; were led or assembled would suit context; see especially Dr Berthol. תְּכוּנָה see כון
